headline: Brazil Lowers 2026 GDP Growth Forecast to 1.9% Amid High Interest Rates
summary: Brazil's Ministry of Finance lowered its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 1.9%, citing slower economic activity, high credit costs, and restrictive interest rates, while inflation is projected at 5.3%.
why: Downward revisions in growth and persistent inflationary pressures reflect restrictive monetary policy impacts on emerging market economic activity.
